notes.title: Update 2.0.0
notes.content:
Update 2.0.0 for Shin Galaxy - Alpha War is available. Check out what's been added below.

[list]
[*] - Added new stages: Zynu and Enferna systems have been added, containing new enemies and challenges.
[*] - Infinite mode has been expanded
[*] - Added V3 ships: More powerful versions of Ignis, Tonitruum, Terra and Aqua.
[*] - Expanded EX stage system
[*] - Added new shot type: Guided laser
[*] - Added new skins
[*] - Bug fixes
[/list]
